notes: Version 2.4 corrects the description of Axiom A3 of the Foundation paper in the open-hypothesis list: A3 is not a non-factorisability axiom. The Foundation paper obtains non-factorisability only under an additional sector reading of A3, not derived (Foundation version 2.6, Lemma 5.6), and the coherence extensivity hypothesis H-ext of Gravity remains an explicit open hypothesis, distinct from that reading. No other statement is changed.
